overview: QuizNova is a polished, fully client-side interactive mock test with a name-gated welcome screen, 10 shuffled technology questions, a 10-minute countdown, and a rich results and answer-review experience.
features: Enter your name to start a personalized quiz
Answer 10 multiple-choice technology questions one at a time
10-minute countdown that auto-submits when time runs out
Jump between questions with a navigation grid that marks answered and unanswered
Confirm before submitting, with answers preserved if you cancel
See your score, percentage and correct/incorrect/unanswered breakdown
Review every question with your answer and the correct answer
Retake the quiz with freshly shuffled questions
